descriptionChirho: A Hebrew proper noun (אֱלִיאָב) meaning 'my God is father', referring to several biblical figures: the eldest son of Jesse and brother of David, a Reubenite leader son of Pallu, a Gadite warrior, a Levite ancestor of Samuel, and others. Rendered as 'Eliab / Eliav' (eng), 'Eliab / Eliav' (spa), 'एलीआब / एलीयाब' (hin), 'أَلِيآبُ / أَلِياب' (arb), '엘리압 / 엘리악' (kor), 'Eliabu' (swa). The two clusters represent the same proper noun with minor transliteration and case-marking variation only.
